_comment: Weathered white oak: flat-sawn oak left outdoors for years, bleached to a silver-grey, the soft earlywood washed out so the latewood stands as raised ribs, open dark pores and pale ray flecks along the grain: a fence rail, deck board or barn timber. Opaque: a solid, matte dielectric. Base textures are generated (L2, tools/converters/base/gen_whiteoak_weathered.py), not scanned: ambientCG has no asset that says white oak or weathered oak (its weathered woods are siding shingles, an assembly), and the library names only what a source states. Condition stays Clean: the drying checks are the Cracks01 wear layer (overlay 1, damage), at 0 (C1), with dust as a deposit (Phase10), gated by the Crevice mask. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: WhiteOak_Weathered_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.why: Mean linear albedo (0.23, 0.215, 0.19), about sRGB 132, 128, 121, for silver-grey weathered oak; roughness about 0.8 for a weathered, raised-grain surface; specular_ior 1.5, a generic dielectric. Physically Based has no wood entry.
